Counts describe unique raw-name/sign combinations in selected saved evidence, not independent artifacts, live accuracy or percentage-reading success.
Comparison baseline is the current glyph matcher without the reviewed word catalogue.
Occurrences may repeat evidence in scan passes, saved items and label samples.
